name: Definium Therapeutics, Inc.
moat_justification: Weak-to-moderate and entirely contingent on approval: the most advanced LSD program in existence (three positive Phase 3 readouts across GAD and MDD, Breakthrough Therapy designation in both, pre-NDA meeting scheduled) plus ODT formulation/dosing IP, regulatory exclusivity if approved, supervised-delivery know-how, and a ~$1.1B cash pile that funds the path to an FDA decision — but the active molecule is lysergide, a long-known off-patent Schedule I compound, so the moat covers a formulation and a protocol, not the molecule; big-pharma-backed rivals (COMPASS, Lilly/AtaiBeckley, AbbVie/Gilgamesh) can route around it, no pricing power or payer coverage is demonstrated, functional unblinding is a live criticism, DEA/state rescheduling sits between approval and revenue, and the pipeline behind DT120 is a single Phase 2a asset.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 42.5%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-26, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: the investing-activities section lists ONLY Purchases of investments $(268,356) thousand and Maturity of investments $116,750 thousand (net $(151,606) thousand) for 2025, with both lines shown as zero for 2024 and no purchases-of-property-and-equipment line anywhere; the balance sheet carries no property and equipment asset line. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed 2025-03-06, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (2024/2023 comparative): the statement has NO investing-activities section at all — for 2023, operating $(64,365) thousand + financing $21,848 thousand + FX $79 thousand equals the reported net decrease in cash $(42,438) thousand, proving investing cash flow (and therefore capex) was $0 in FY2023; same reconciliation for 2024 (operating $(79,129) + financing $253,196 + FX $(30) = reported $174,037 increase).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
one_liner: Pre-revenue single-asset psychedelic biotech, moat 4/10 contingent on approval — owner's earnings are negative in all 6 years of history (TTM -$1.79/share) despite three positive Phase 3 DT120 trials in GAD/MDD and ~$1.1B cash and investments, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; the $34.56 price is an FDA-approval option, not an earnings stream.
moat_for: Execution/data lead in psychedelic psychiatry — three positive Phase 3 trials across GAD and MDD, Breakthrough Therapy designation in both
Formulation and dosing IP around the ODT lysergide product (Zydis fast-dissolve) plus regulatory exclusivity if approved
Delivery know-how: supervised single-dose model with ~6-hour discharge aimed at the existing interventional-psychiatry site base
Balance-sheet staying power — ~$1.1B cash and investments at Q2 2026 funds operations into 2030, so the lead does not die for lack of cash before the FDA decides
moat_against: Active molecule is lysergide — a long-known, off-patent Schedule I compound; the moat covers formulation and protocol, not the molecule
Big-pharma-backed rivals can route around it with differentiated compounds (COMPASS psilocybin, Lilly/AtaiBeckley, AbbVie/Gilgamesh)
Zero pricing power demonstrated — no approved product, no payer contracts; reimbursement for a supervised multi-hour session is unproven
Functional unblinding is a live scientific criticism of every psychedelic trial, pressable by payers and FDA reviewers
Single-asset concentration — DT402 is only Phase 2a; if DT120 stumbles at FDA there is no second leg
